mapper.select: SELECT * FROM inventory ORDER BY id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO inventory (variety, stock_kg, warn_line, updated_at) VALUES (#{variety}, 0, #{warnLine}, NOW()) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE updated_at = NOW()
mapper.update: UPDATE inventory SET stock_kg = stock_kg + #{kg}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE variety = #{variety}
UPDATE inventory SET stock_kg = stock_kg - #{kg}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE variety = #{variety}
